title: One facade module opens the S3 client on boot and emits facadeReady with endpoint host and bucket name
asA: developer whose service needs S3-shape object storage behind a swappable boundary
iWant: one facade module to hold the S3 client and expose named domain verbs, with a facadeReady lifecycle event on the first successful ready-check
soThat: the boundary between my domain and the S3 vendor surface is the only place that has to move when the adapter changes, and boot ordering is observable via the event

acceptanceCriteria.description: On process boot, the facade opens an S3 client against the elicited endpoint URL and bucket name; once the first successful ready-check (a HeadBucket or equivalent metadata call) returns, a facadeReady event fires on the injected event sink with a payload containing endpoint host and bucket name.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a Node process with the facade module imported and its factory invoked
acceptanceCriteria.when: the process boots and the facade's ready-check returns
acceptanceCriteria.then: a facadeReady event fires on the injected event sink with a payload containing endpointHost and bucketName, and the client is ready to accept verbs; the facade exposes named domain verbs and does not re-export the raw S3 client

acceptanceCriteria.description: Exactly one source-tree module inside the facade directory imports the S3 client (@aws-sdk/client-s3 or aws4fetch per ADR-2901); every other module that touches object storage imports the facade and calls its named domain verbs, verified by a targeted grep on the applied fixture.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the applied project's source tree after apply
acceptanceCriteria.when: grep 'from \'@aws-sdk/client-s3\'' or 'from \'aws4fetch\'' walks the tree outside the facade directory
acceptanceCriteria.then: no match is found outside the facade directory; the facade's public surface exports named domain verbs only, no raw S3 client reference

acceptanceCriteria.description: Facade refuses at boot when the elicited endpoint is unreachable. Given the elicited s3-endpoint-url resolves to a host the runner cannot reach (or refuses a ready-check inside the connection timeout), when the facade opens on boot, then the facade refuses with a named error kind (endpointUnreachable) carrying the endpoint host but no credential material, and facadeReady does not fire.
acceptanceCriteria.given: s3-endpoint-url resolves to an unreachable host or times out on ready-check
acceptanceCriteria.then: the facade refuses with endpointUnreachable carrying host but no credentials; facadeReady does not fire

acceptanceCriteria.description: S3 adapter aws-sdk-client-s3. Given the elicited s3-adapter answers aws-sdk-client-s3, when the facade opens on process boot, then the facade constructs one `new S3Client(...)` from @aws-sdk/client-s3 v3 and the outbound HeadBucket request carries the SDK's default User-Agent header of shape `aws-sdk-js/<version> ...` (grep on the client's user-agent middleware output confirms the aws-sdk-js prefix); the aws4fetch package is NOT present in the facade module's imports; a grep across the applied source refuses any import of aws4fetch outside the facade.
acceptanceCriteria.when: the facade opens on boot and issues its first HeadBucket ready-check
acceptanceCriteria.then: the facade constructs one S3Client from @aws-sdk/client-s3 v3 and the outbound HeadBucket carries a User-Agent starting with `aws-sdk-js/`; aws4fetch is absent from the applied source
